howto_help:
Quick Stash Ctrl+clicks items for you.
Transfer empties your backpack into whatever panel is open on the other side (stash, guild stash, vendor, trade window).
TAKE pulls the items matching the game's own "Highlight Items" search out of the open stash tab into your backpack.
Turn off POEFixer's own auto-stash while you use this plugin: both Ctrl+click.
howto_steps:
1. Open your inventory and a storage panel.
2. Transfer: click the Transfer button above your backpack.
3. TAKE: type in the game's search box under the stash; a TAKE button appears above the box and the matching items are outlined. Click TAKE.
Right-click, alt-tab or opening the POEFixer menu stops a running transfer.
howto_waiting: Waiting for the game (in game and in front)
howto_no_storage: No storage tab with items on screen
transfer_help:
Each cell is a backpack slot. Items touching a red cell stay in your bag; everything else is Ctrl+clicked into the open panel, row by row.
With a vendor open, Ctrl+click sells; with a trade window open, it offers the item.
transfer_hint: Click or drag across cells to choose what stays in your bag.
transfer_preset_left_tip: Keeps the items in the leftmost column (the default).
take_help:
TAKE reads the game's own "Highlight Items" box under the stash. The search works like the game's: words separated by spaces must all match, "quoted text" is one phrase, !word excludes, a|b matches either, and regular expressions work.
An empty box takes the whole tab. TAKE never touches your backpack or equipment.
Careful: with a vendor window open, Ctrl+click buys.
take_show_button_tip:
Shows TAKE above the game's search box while a stash tab is open.
Turn it off if you only use Transfer; the plugin then stops reading the search box.
take_read_mods_tip:
Also matches words in the items' mods ("rarity", "pack size", "corrupted"),
like the game's highlight. Mods are read only while something is typed.
take_mod_language_tip:
Mod lines are always searchable in English. Pick your game client's language to
search its mod wording too. Automatic uses the game language POEFixer knows, else the
language of the search box label.
take_outline: Outline the items TAKE will grab
take_outline_tip: Draws a box around every matching item, so you see the selection before clicking.
take_outline_colour_tip:
Colour and opacity of the boxes.
The fill uses a fifth of this opacity.
buttons_help: The buttons follow the game's inventory size, so they keep their place at any resolution.
buttons_hint: Move or resize the Transfer and TAKE buttons if they cover something.
buttons_size_tip: Size of the Transfer and TAKE buttons and the progress panel.
buttons_move_x_tip:
Moves the Transfer button sideways from its place above the backpack.
Ctrl+click to type a value.
buttons_move_y_tip:
Moves the Transfer button up (negative) or down (positive).
Ctrl+click to type a value.
timing_help: Raise these if items are sometimes skipped or picked up onto the cursor instead of moving (slow PC, high latency). Lower them for faster runs.
timing_between_tip: Pause before moving to the next item.
timing_after_click_tip:
Wait after a click before the next step,
so the game registers it.
timing_settle_tip:
Wait after moving the cursor onto an item
before clicking it.
timing_hold_tip:
How long Ctrl stays pressed after the last click, so the last item still moves.
Never shorter than 60 ms or the "after each click" wait.
safety_right_click_tip: Pressing the right mouse button stops a running transfer or TAKE.
safety_verify_panels_tip:
Stops when your inventory closes, and stops TAKE when the stash closes
or you switch to another stash tab.
safety_hint: Always on: alt-tab, opening the POEFixer menu or losing the game window stops a run, and TAKE stops when your backpack is full.
transfer_grid_tip:
Click a cell to toggle it, or hold the mouse button and drag across cells.
Red cells: items touching them stay in your bag.
Green cells: their items are transferred.
diag_tip: The background reader's numbers and a one-click capture of what the plugin sees, for bug reports.
diag_hint: For bug reports. Open your inventory and a stash tab, type in the game's search box, then press Capture. Nothing is read until you do.
diag_reader: Background reader: pass {pass} ms, UI elements {elements}, cached item texts {texts}, last reading {age} ms ago, faults {faults}
diag_capture_tip:
Reads the inventories, the open tab's first 40 items with their mods,
and the visible game UI texts once. Expect a short hitch.
diag_copy_tip:
Copies the report to the clipboard and saves it as config/text-report.txt
in the plugin folder. Attach it, with your game language and search text, to a bug report.
diag_copied_not_saved: Copied {bytes} bytes; the file could not be saved
diag_items_hint: The text TAKE searches for each item: names, then mods. A word missing here cannot match.
